name: ThemeToggle
summary: The light/dark switch, with colour in the glyph: a dark moon in the light theme, the brand yellow sun in the dark one.

a11y.keyboardNote: A native <button> (the IconButton). Its name says where it goes — "Switch to dark theme" / "Switch to light theme" — and changes with the theme. With mode="light-dark-system" it is a radio group named "Theme": Tab enters on the chosen option, the arrows move and choose.

props.name: mode
props.description: light-dark is the button that flips the theme. light-dark-system is the reference's three-way switch — light, dark and system (follow the computer, and change with it): a radio group of three icon options, the chosen one filled.

props.name: size
props.description: The IconButton size. The button is round, like every icon-only button (ADR-0052).

props.name: pressed
props.description: Inherited from IconButton, where it is deprecated. The toggle's state is the document theme, not this prop.

props.name: grow
props.description: Inherited from Button: the button takes the free space of its row.
